units.source_text: 我们还没有用完早餐，老师出发的时间到了。

en.t: We had not yet finished breakfast when it was time for the teacher to depart.

units.source_text: 按寺庙的规矩，老师出门，寺庙众憎都要在正门前列队欢送。

en.t: According to the temple rules, when the teacher went out, all the monks of the temple had to line up in front of the main gate to see him off.
